committee: House of Representatives Standing Committee on Procedure
document_title: Australian Government Response to the House of Representatives Standing Committee on Procedure report: Division required? Electronic voting in the House of Representatives
recommendation: The Committee recommends that the results of divisions be displayed in the Chamber

document_title: Australian Government response to the Joint Standing Committee on Treaties report: Australia-India Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement [May 2024]
recommendation: The Committee supports the Australia-India Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement and recommends that binding treaty action be taken
the_claim: The Government has implemented this recommendation.

document_title: Government response to the Statutory inquiry into ASIC, the Takeovers Panel, and the corporations legislation, ‘Competition in clearing and settlement and the ASX CHESS Replacement Project: The CHESS Replacement Project is too important to fail’
recommendation: The Committee recommends that the Minister proceed as quickly as practical to implement the ministerial determinations to empower the Australian Securities and Investments Commission to make rules to facilitate competition or fair provision of monopoly clearing and settlement services in line with the Council of Financial Regulators’ recommendations
the_claim: The Government has actioned this recommendation.

document_title: Government response to the Statutory inquiry into ASIC, the Takeovers Panel, and the corporations legislation, ‘Competition in clearing and settlement and the ASX CHESS Replacement Project: The CHESS Replacement Project is too important to fail’
recommendation: The Committee recommends that the Government progress the Financial Market Infrastructure reforms as soon as practical
the_claim: The Government has actioned this recommendation.

document_title: Australian Government Response to the National Cultural Policy Interim Report
recommendation: The Committee recommends the Australian Government prioritise the introduction of its legislative reforms for local content requirements for streaming services to the Australian Parliament
the_claim: The government has delivered this recommendation.
